title: UK Chief Secretary to the Treasury Lucy Rigby warns that rejecting AI in public services means choosing "decline", vowing to prioritize its Whitehall rollout (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: UK Chief Secretary to the Treasury Lucy Rigby warns that rejecting AI in public services means choosing “decline”, vowing to prioritize its Whitehall rollout — Newly appointed chief secretary to the Treasury Lucy Rigby wants to roll out technology across Whitehall
